elements.manual_reason: The cursor has no dedicated candidate box (b04 is the dropdown row it leaves); it drifts down slightly after the click.
elements.label: Cursor

pattern.description: Clicking the 'Acme Voice & Tone Guidelines' option in the Link-to-page dropdown inserts a bold page-mention pill at the end of the AI prompt text, and the dropdown disappears at the same moment.
pattern.why_premium: One click visibly converts into context attached to the prompt; the instant swap (menu gone, chip in place) keeps the demo snappy and shows grounding in a company doc without narration.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.mention-menu', {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.08, ease: 'power1.out'}).set('.prompt .mention-chip', {autoAlpha: 1}, '<') -- the chip is a hard set (UI insert), no tween; cursor x/y tweened with power2.out.
build_hint.remotion: At click frame f: menuOpacity = interpolate(frame, [f, f+2], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); chip rendered when frame >= f (no spring); cursor drift via interpolate with Easing.out(Easing.quad).

notes: Chip insert and menu removal look like instant UI state changes (energy spikes at single frames), so durations are guesses. Cursor manual_box is approximate.
